nodes.trajectory_interpretation: The trajectory shows a mix of economy (Drone, Hatchery, Extractor), air (Mutalisk, Corruptor), and defense (SporeCrawler, Queen). This suggests a balanced approach with an emphasis on air.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overcommitting to Zerglings without support against Reaper harassment; avoid neglecting creep spread and defensive positioning.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing economy and technology while strengthening ground army and maintaining defense. Increase economy, maintain expansion and production, continue technology and upgrades.

execution_envelope.fallback_rule: If the preferred candidate is not reachable before the next decision, use a cheaper currently producible trajectory candidate; do not queue a long blocked prerequisite chain while army supply is low.
execution_envelope.feedback_rule: If the bank/low-army deficit persists for two decisions, stop repeating the same plan, re-read the best matching node, and choose a different reachable candidate or producer bottleneck repair.
execution_envelope.resource_conversion_trigger: When the combined bank is at least 750 and army supply is still below 15 after 05:00, prefer a currently executable combat candidate from this pool before optional greed or deeper technology.
execution_envelope.selection_rule: Choose only a currently reachable candidate after checking live producers, prerequisites, resources, supply, and active queues; this is a candidate pool, not an ordered build list.
